title: Current and former employees say TikTok US still coordinates closely with the global TikTok org, and US staff continue to use ByteDance's internal chat app Lark (Sylvia Varnham O'Regan/Politico)
summary: Sylvia Varnham O'Regan / Politico: Current and former employees say TikTok US still coordinates closely with the global TikTok org, and US staff continue to use ByteDance's internal chat app Lark — In the months before TikTok finalized a deal to sell its U.S. operations to a group of investors friendly to President Donald Trump …
